Vignettes for the `v0.2.x` line of Canek, kept for reference. These
document workflows and defaults that predate `0.3.0`'s PCA-embedding-space
correction (`correctEmbeddings = TRUE`) — see the current vignettes linked
from the [README](https://martinloza.github.io/Canek/index.html) for
up-to-date usage.

- [Run Canek on Seurat objects (gene-expression-space
  correction)](seurat_gene_expression.html)
- [Best practices on batch effects correction](Best_practices_thymus.html)
